stages.title: Language ki shuruaat
stages.goal: Variables se start karke ek waqt ek chhota concept samjho.
stages.checkpoint: Function, loop aur condition se lessons array ke total study minutes nikalo.

stages.title: Data aur scope samjho
stages.goal: Collections transform, input validate aur bindings/built-in utilities samjho.
stages.checkpoint: Closure explain karo aur accidental string concatenation ke bina validated calculation banao.

stages.title: Browser mein interactions banao
stages.goal: DOM manipulate karne se pehle HTML/CSS structure seekho.
stages.checkpoint: Keyboard-accessible list banao jiske actions delegation se handle hon.

stages.title: Objects aur design samjho
stages.goal: OOP project se pehle this receiver aur prototypes samjho.
stages.checkpoint: Three call sites ka this explain karke small state-machine project implement karo.

stages.title: Async work aur delivery sambhalo
stages.goal: Promises/fetch se concurrency limits aur modules tak badho.
stages.checkpoint: Failed request handle, active work cap aur browser tak app delivery explain karo.

stages.title: Code ka behavior verify karo
stages.goal: Modules aur async knowledge ko repeatable tests aur debugging workflow se verify karo.
stages.checkpoint: Boundary tests aur controlled async failure case run karke regression explain karo.

stages.title: Persistence aur collaboration samjho
stages.goal: Local data lifecycle, offline conflicts aur reviewed Git changes practice karo.
stages.checkpoint: Two-tab conflict policy aur staged/unstaged diff ka exact meaning explain karo.

stages.title: Pehle components samjho
stages.goal: JSX/props se start, phir state, rendering aur identity seekho.
stages.checkpoint: Editable list mein drafts correct items ke saath attached rakho.

stages.title: UI reuse aur safe synchronization
stages.goal: Composition ke baad effects, refs aur custom hooks seekho.
stages.checkpoint: Reusable component extract karo aur cancellable effect cleanup karo.

stages.title: Complete application jodo
stages.goal: Navigation, shared state, server cache aur typed boundaries add karo.
stages.checkpoint: Clear cache identity aur validated API data wali routed page banao.

stages.title: Measure karke practice karo
stages.goal: Machine coding se pehle production behavior profile karo.
stages.checkpoint: Stale-request protection, keyboard behavior aur ek measured improvement dikhao.

stages.title: User journey test karo
stages.goal: Forms, async screens aur accessibility ke observable contracts check karo.
stages.checkpoint: Accessible queries se form test likho aur browser-only checks separately identify karo.

stages.title: Pehla Java program likho
stages.goal: main run, variables declare, decisions, methods aur instances banao.
stages.checkpoint: Two independent objects aur array-processing method wala learner program compile karo.

stages.title: Reliable core model banao
stages.goal: Basic classes par OOP, collections, exceptions, streams aur memory reasoning build karo.
stages.checkpoint: Suitable collection choose, equality contract preserve aur owned resource close karo.

stages.title: Build, test aur data save karo
stages.goal: Database/SQL concurrency se pehle builds aur tests setup karo.
stages.checkpoint: JDBC operation test karo; join aur atomic inventory update explain karo.

stages.title: Concurrency aur resource limits samjho
stages.goal: Thread safety, virtual threads aur bounded resources seekho.
stages.checkpoint: Race-safe operation dikhao aur backpressure ki need explain karo.

stages.title: Types, schema aur object design evolve karo
stages.goal: Finite variants, metadata, compatible migrations aur invariant-based low-level design practice karo.
stages.checkpoint: Immutable model, safe migration aur concurrent loan claim ka contract verify karo.

stages.title: Application start aur configure karo
stages.goal: Boot startup, bean wiring aur typed config samjho.
stages.checkpoint: App start karke missing bean/invalid setting diagnose karo.

stages.title: Clear HTTP boundary banao
stages.goal: DTOs, validation aur controlled errors ke saath REST endpoints banao.
stages.checkpoint: Successful creation aur rejected input ke documented responses dikhao.

stages.title: Business operations save aur secure karo
stages.goal: Transactions, persistence aur authorization boundaries apply karo.
stages.checkpoint: Concurrent requests mein invariant bache aur unauthorized access reject ho, prove karo.

stages.title: Service verify aur operate karo
stages.goal: Boundaries test, telemetry inspect aur deployment capstone complete karo.
stages.checkpoint: API acceptance cases run karke failed-deployment recovery defend karo.

stages.title: Background work aur cache operate karo
stages.goal: Proxy boundaries, scheduled jobs aur cache identity ko failure scenarios se connect karo.
stages.checkpoint: Duplicate job aur stale cache recovery ka measurable contract do.

stages.title: Web runtime ko neeche tak trace karo
stages.goal: Servlet concurrency, forwarding aur view rendering ko Spring MVC se connect karo.
stages.checkpoint: Shared request-field race aur redirect attribute loss diagnose karo.

stages.title: Optional AI retrieval extension
stages.goal: Authorized retrieval, evidence quality aur model integration ki limits samjho.
stages.checkpoint: Known, unsupported aur unauthorized questions ka evaluation contract do.

stages.title: Server request samjho
stages.goal: Node/HTTP ke baad Express routing aur errors seekho.
stages.checkpoint: Request ko middleware se controlled response tak trace karo.

stages.title: Data ka model banao
stages.goal: Mongoose schema se pehle documents aur CRUD samjho.
stages.checkpoint: Actual read pattern se embedding/references choose aur writes validate karo.

stages.title: Efficient queries likho
stages.goal: Indexes/aggregation ke baad plans aur bounded streaming inspect karo.
stages.checkpoint: Tenant query ka winning plan explain aur large export stream karo.

stages.title: Secure karke deploy karo
stages.goal: Payments/uploads/deployment se pehle authentication/authorization add karo.
stages.checkpoint: Unauthorized access reject aur duplicate webhook se safely recover karo.

stages.title: API lifecycle verify karo
stages.goal: Real HTTP testing, database isolation aur bounded shutdown practice karo.
stages.checkpoint: Parallel-safe request test aur in-flight shutdown acceptance cases run karo.

stages.title: Cost aur basic structures samjho
stages.goal: Patterns se pehle complexity, lists/stacks/queues aur hashing seekho.
stages.checkpoint: Array, queue ya map choose karke operation cost justify karo.

stages.title: Reusable problem-solving patterns seekho
stages.goal: Counters/pointers/search ke baad recursion aur sorting padho.
stages.checkpoint: Code se pehle binary-search invariant aur recursive call trace karo.

stages.title: Ordered candidates aur hierarchy samjho
stages.goal: Stack invariant apply, phir trees/heaps, uske baad graphs seekho.
stages.checkpoint: Stack ka complexity bound prove aur heap-based top-k implement karo.

stages.title: Graphs aur DP solve karo
stages.goal: Queues, recursion, hashing/heaps se dependencies aur repeated subproblems samjho.
stages.checkpoint: BFS/Dijkstra choose karo, phir DP state/recurrence derive karo.

stages.title: Advanced choices ko prove karo
stages.goal: Greedy/interval proofs aur trie, bitmask, range-query structures seekho.
stages.checkpoint: Greedy ko brute-force oracle se compare karo aur Fenwick update trace karo.

stages.title: Design ki common foundation
stages.goal: Scaling/cache choose karne se pehle requirements/capacity clear karo.
stages.checkpoint: Workload, latency, freshness aur correctness assumptions likho.

stages.title: React frontend architecture samjho
stages.goal: Frontend case se pehle rendering, state aur performance design karo.
stages.checkpoint: URL state, cache aur stale-request handling wala accessible catalog banao.

stages.title: Java backend architecture samjho
stages.goal: API/data boundaries ke baad messaging, reliability aur operations padho.
stages.checkpoint: Reservation invariant, retry identity aur failure timeline explain karo.

stages.title: End-to-end case studies karo
stages.goal: Dono sides padhkar frontend/backend reasoning combine karo.
stages.checkpoint: Checkout/reconnect failure mein durable state bachne ka flow trace karo.

stages.title: Distributed guarantees aur API contracts defend karo
stages.goal: Read consistency, global limits aur API styles ko workload/failure history se compare karo.
stages.checkpoint: Replica lag, limiter outage aur batch lookup failure ke expected outcomes define karo.

stages.title: OS aur networking fundamentals se diagnose karo
stages.goal: Request latency ko process, memory, network aur shared-resource layers mein trace karo.
stages.checkpoint: DNS/TCP/TLS failure, pool wait aur unknown write outcome ko evidence se separate karo.

stages.title: Language interview practice karo
stages.goal: Jo language course complete kiya, uska playbook lo.
stages.checkpoint: Answer dekhe bina output explain aur design choice defend karo.

stages.title: Application interview practice karo
stages.goal: Language se frontend aur database-backed scenarios par badho.
stages.checkpoint: Errors ke saath ek machine-coding/query-design drill complete karo.

stages.title: Algorithms aur architecture practice karo
stages.goal: Related DSA/design course ke baad yeh rounds karo.
stages.checkpoint: Coding mein invariant aur design mein measurable requirement batao.
